evidence.description: Report number 25-030036: patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at a restaurant and bar in Northwest Rochester, MN, on Tuesday, April 15, 2025.
A tool was noted. A circular saw was used to cut around the side of the ATM and take the cash.
Police list records an ATM incident at this business on this date.
Footage, point of entry and damage are all recorded as not reported.
